Please ensure that the UKPRN in your file (or MIS application) matches the UKPRN of your Submit Learner Data account. Name: Namespace_Mismatch

ErrorMessage: There is no Adult skills funding relationship for this UKPRN
Intent: To ensure that there is a live contract for delivery of the Adult skills fund provision associated with the file upload.
Guidance: Please ensure that, to avoid this rule is triggering, you have an active and signed contract in your MyESF service. This rule may also trigger an error where the contract is signed and a file uploaded on the same day; in this case please resubmit your file upload on the following day.
Description: If the learning aim is Adult education funded (FM = 35) there must be an active contract relationship in FCT for this UKPRN, to fund this provision
DetailedDescription:
If the learning aim is Adult skills funded (LearningDelivery.FundModel = 35) there must be a funding relationship in FCT for this UKPRN (LearningProvider.UKPRN = ContractAllocation.DeliveryUKPRN)

(error where there is no funding relationship in FCT ContractAllocation.FundingStreamPeriodCode = ASFC-ASCL2627, STFIG2627, ASFC-FCFJ2627)
Exclusions:
This rule is not triggered by apprenticeships (DD07 = Y), (LearningDelivery.LearnDelFAMType = LDM and LearningDelivery.LearnDelFAMCode = 357, 
OLASS - Offender in Custody (LearningDelivery.LearnDelFAMType = LDM and LearningDelivery.LearnDelFAMCode = 034'), where the LearningDelivery.LearnActEndDate is known and in the previous teaching year,
combined authorities (DD35 =Y),
19-24 Traineeships - 2020 procurement (LearningDelivery.LearnDelFAMType = LDM and LearningDelivery.LearnDelFAMCode = 377),
Procured Adult Education Budget 2021 (AEB) (LearningDelivery.LearnDelFAMType = LDM and LearningDelivery.LearnDelFAMCode = 379)
Procured Adult Education Budget 2023 (AEB) (LearningDelivery.LearnDelFAMType = LDM and LearningDelivery.LearnDelFAMCode = 388
ChangeSummary: Version 2 - Funding stream period codes have been updated with ASFC-ASCL2627, STFIG2627, ASFC-FCFJ2627

Flowchart for 'UKPRN_06' rule
1. Is the learning aim apprenticeship, OLASS and completed in a previous year, 19-24 traineeships, or Procured AEB 2021 or 2023?
If 'Yes' then the rule is not triggeredIf 'No' then:
2.  Is the aim Adult skills funded (FM = 35)?
If 'No' then the rule is not triggeredIf 'Yes' then:
3. Is there a funding relationship in FCT for the UKPRN?

Name: UKPRN_16
ErrorMessage: This learning aim cannot be started after the Stop New Starts date for this funding relationship
Intent: To ensure that there are no new starts under the delivery contract once a 'Stop New Starts' order has been placed on it.
Guidance: Where a 'Stop New Starts' order has been placed on the contract for delivery, no new starts can be returned until this order has been removed from the contract.
Description: If the learning aim is identified as procured non levy (ACT = 2 and FM = 36)  there must be a funding relationship in FCT for this UKPRN, but the aim cannot be started on or after the Stop New Starts date of the latest contract start date.
DetailedDescription:
If the learning aim is identified as procured non levy (LearningDelivery.LearnDelFAMType = ACT and LearningDelivery.LearnDelFAMCode = 2) and (LearningDelivery.AimType = 1) and (LearningDelivery.FundModel = 36)  there must be a funding relationship in FCT for this UKPRN (LearningProvider.UKPRN = ContractAllocation.DeliveryUKPRN and ContractAllocation.FundingStreamPeriodCode = 16-18NLAP2018, ANLAP2018), it cannot be started on or after the Stop New Starts date of the latest contract start date in FCT (ContractAllocation.StartDate)

(error where ContractAllocation.StopNewStartsFromDate is not null and LearningDelivery.LearnStartDate >= ContractAllocation.StopNewStartsFromDate of the latest ContractAllocation.StartDate in FCT)
Exclusions: This rule is not triggered by Restarts (LearningDelivery.LearnDelFAMType = RES)
ChangeSummary: Version 1 - The rule has been rolled over from the previous year
FlowChartDetails:
Flowchart for 'UKPRN_16' rule
1. Is the aim a Restart?
If 'Yes' then the rule is not triggeredIf 'No' then:
2.  Is the programme aim part of a procured non-levy apprenticeship (ACT = 2)?
If 'No' then the rule is not triggeredIf 'Yes' then:
3. Is there a 'Stop new starts' instruction in FCT for the UKPRN?
If 'No' then the rule is not triggeredIf 'Yes' then:
4. Is the programme start date after the 'Stop new starts' instruction?
If 'No' then the rule is not triggeredIf 'Yes' then the rule is triggered

Intent: This rule ensures that the Maths minimum hours has been returned for an applicable programme
Guidance: If the learner is 16 or over on the 31 August and if the aim is 16-19 funded and if the aim has EFA Funding Condition and the learner's planned hours are 150 or over, then the Maths Minimum Hours must be returned to clear this error, unless they have a pass grade for Maths functional skills
Description: If the learner is 16 or over on the 31 August and if the aim is 16-19 funded and if the aim has EFA Funding Condition with no valid exemptions the Maths minimum hours must be returned
DetailedDescription:
If the learner is 16 or over on the 31 August and if the aim is 16-19 funded and if the aim has EFA Funding Condition - Maths qualification validity category  (LARS_ValidityCategory = EFAConFundMaths) or an aim under the King's Trust TEAM programme, the learner does not hold a GCSE Maths condition of funding exemption ( there is no record of LearnFamType. MCF and Learner.LearnFAMCode = 1,2,3,4), the learner's highest Maths GCSE grade is 3,2,1,U,D,E,F,G,X,NONE (Learner.MathGrade = 3,2,1,U,D,E,F,G,X,NONE) and the learner's planned hours are 150 or over, then the Maths Minimum Hours must be returned.

Error where
Learner.DateOfBirth is returned and >= 16 years on the 31 August of the current teaching year
and
LearningDelivery.FundModel = 25
and
LearningDeliveryFAM.LearnDelFAMType = SOF and LearningDeliveryFAM.LearnDelFAMCode = 107
And
(LearningDelivery.LearnAimRef = LARS_LearnAimRef and LARS_ValidityCategory = EFAConFundMaths or (LearningDelivery.LearnAimRef = LARS_LearnAimRef = 60023995,60027307,60027629,60032121,60033344 and LearningDeliveryFAM.LearnDelFAMType = LDM and LearningDeliveryFAM.LearnDelFAMCode = 331))
and
there is no record of Learner.FAM LearnFamType.MCF and Learner.LearnFAMCode = 1,2,3,4
And
Learner.MathGrade = 3,2,1,U,D,E,F,G,X,NONE
and
(Learner.PlanLearnHours+Learner.PlanEEPHours = > 150 or (LearningDelivery.ProgType = 31 and LearningDelivery.AimType = 1 with the latest LearningDelivery.LearnStartDate and  HRSRecord.HRSType = HRS and HRSRecord.HRSCode = 2 and HRSRecord.HRSAmount  = >150 )) 
and
there is no record where LearnerFAM.LearnFAMType = MMH
Exclusions:
This rule is not triggered by:

Learner holds a pass grade for functional skills level 2 in Maths and Maths GCSE grade is below grade 3 (LearnerFAM.LearnFamType.MCF  Learner.LearnFAMCode = 5 and Learner.MathGrade = 2,1,U,E,F,G,X,NONE)

If 'Yes' then the rule is not triggeredIf 'No' then the rule is triggered

LearnerFAM.LearnFAMCode,

Guidance: Ensure that a completed skills bootcamp programme aim is recorded with the achievement date or at least one of the Skills Bootcamp event aims are present in the ILR file.
Description: For completed Skills Bootcamp programmes, the Achievement Date must be returned on the latest programme aim or at least one of the Skills Bootcamp event aims must be present in the Learning Delivery record.
DetailedDescription:
For completed Skills Bootcamp programmes starting on or prior to 31 July 2025 (LearningDelivery.LearnStartDate <= 2025-07-31) , the Achievement Date must be returned on the latest programme aim or at least one of the Skills Bootcamp event aims must be present in the Learning Delivery record.

error where
LearningDelivery.LearnStartDate <= 2025-07-31
LearningDelivery.ProgType = 32
And 
LearningDelivery.AimType = 1 
And
LearningDelivery.CompStatus = 2
And 
LearningDelivery.AchDate for the latest programme aim is not returned or NULL
And 
there is no Learning Delivery record exists where at least one aim is LearningDelivery.LearnAimRef = Z0059747, Z0059748, Z0059749
Exclusions:
This rule is not triggered by:
Completed programme aims where the file preparation date is six months after the Learning Actual End Date
(LearningDelivery.AimType = 1
and
LearningDelivery.CompStatus = 2 
and 
file preparation date > 6 months after LearningDelivery.LearnActEndDate)
ChangeSummary: Version 1 - The rule has been rolled over from the previous year
FlowChartDetails:
Flowchart for 'R138' rule
1. Has a completed Skills bootcamp programme aim been returned within the last 6 months? 
If 'No' then the rule is not triggeredIf 'Yes' then:
2. Has an achievement date or a event aim been returned?
If 'Yes' then the rule is not triggeredIf 'No' then the rule is triggered

Name: DateOfBirth_60
ErrorMessage: The learner is not able to be funded for a level 7 apprenticeship because they are either over 21 or are under 25 and are not an apprentice care leaver or have an EHC plan.
Intent: To ensure that a learner does not start on a funded level 7 apprenticeship if they do not meet the eligibility criteria
Guidance: Ensure that, the learners date of birth is recoded correctly, if they are under the age of 25 but over 21 they require an EHCP or a care leaver to be eligible. If the learner does not fit the eligibility criteria they are not valid for funding and the error is triggering correctly and the learner should be removed.
Description: For level 7 apprenticeship standard programmes starting on or after 1 January 2026, then the learner must be 16-21 at the start of the aim or be an apprentice care leaver and be under 25 years old at the start of the aim or have an 'Education health care plan' and be under 25 years old at the start of the aim.
DetailedDescription:
For level 7 apprenticeship standard programmes starting on or after 1 January 2026, then the learner must be 16-21 at the start of the aim or be an apprentice care leaver and be under 25 years old at the start of the aim or have an 'Education health care plan' and be under 25 years old at the start of the aim.

error where
LearningDelivery.LearnStartDate >= 2026-01-01
and
LearningDelivery.FundModel = 36
and
LearningDelivery.ProgType = 25
and
LearningDelivery.AimType = 1
and
LearningDelivery.StdCode = LARS_StandardCode
and
LARS_NotionalEndLevel = 7 
and
NOT (LearningDelivery.LearnStartDate - Learner.DateOfBirth is between 16 and 21)
and
NOT (LearningDeliveryFAM.LearnDelFAMType = LDM and LearningDeliveryFAM.LearnDelFAMCode = 362 and LearningDelivery.LearnStartDate - Learner.DateOfBirth < 25 years)
and
NOT (LearnerFAM.LearnFAMType = EHC and LearningDelivery.LearnStartDate - Learner.DateOfBirth < 25 years)
Exclusions: This rule is not not triggered by aims that are a restart (LearningDeliveryFAM.LearnDelFAMType = RES)
ChangeSummary: Version 1 - The rule has been rolled over from the previous year
FlowChartDetails:
Flowchart for 'DateOfBirth_60' rule
1. Is the programme a Restart?
If 'Yes' then the rule is not triggeredIf 'No' then:
2. Is the start date on or after the 1 January 2026? 
If 'No' then the rule is not triggeredIf 'Yes' then:
3. Is the aim an apprenticeship standard?
If 'No' then the rule is not triggeredIf 'Yes' then:
4. Is the aim a programme aim?
If 'No' then the rule is not triggeredIf 'Yes' then:
5. Is the programme a notional level 7 standard in the LARS lookup?
If 'No' then the rule is not triggeredIf 'Yes' then:
6. At the start of the aim is the learner aged 16 - 21, an apprentice care leaver who is under 25, or under 25 with an EHC plan?
If 'Yes' then the rule is not triggeredIf 'No' then the rule is triggered
FieldValues:
Learner.DateOfBirth,
LearningDelivery.LearnStartDate,
LearningDelivery.FundModel,
LearningDelivery.AimType,
LearningDelivery.ProgType,
LearningDelivery.StdCode,
LearningDeliveryFAM.LearnDelFAMType,
LearningDeliveryFAM.LearnDelFAMCode

Name: R_150
ErrorMessage: The learning start date of this aim cannot before the learning start date of the programme aim
Intent: This rule ensures that the Skills Bootcamp programme is recorded correctly
Guidance: Ensure that the start date of the event learning aim is not before the start date of any associated programme aim
Description: For a Skills Bootcamp learner starting a programme on or after 1 August 2024 and on or prior to 31 July 2025, the learning start date of the event aim must not be before the earliest start date of any programme aims with the same contract reference number.
DetailedDescription:
For a Skills Bootcamp learner starting a programme on or after 1 August 2024 
and on or prior to 31 July 2025 (LearningDelivery.LearnStartDate <= 2025-07-31), if returned, the learning start date of the event aims must not be before the earliest start date of any programme aims with the same contract reference number.

LearningDelivery.LearnStartDate >= 2024-08-01
and
LearningDelivery.LearnStartDate <= 2025-07-31
and
LearningDelivery.AimType = 1
and
LearningDelivery.ProgType = 32
and

ChangeSummary: Version 1 - The rule has been rolled over from the previous year

Flowchart for 'R150' rule

If 'No' then the rule is not triggeredIf 'Yes' then:

If 'No' then the rule is not triggeredIf 'Yes' then:

If 'No' then the rule is not triggeredIf 'Yes' then then the rule is triggered

Name: DateOfBirth_47
ErrorMessage: The actual duration of the programme does not reach the required minimum duration for an apprenticeship standard
Intent: To ensure that learners who started a funding model FM = 81 or 36 apprenticeship, have an actual programme duration of 365 days or more
Guidance: Ensure that, for learners who started a funding model FM = 81 or 36 apprenticeship on or after 1 August 2016, where the learner has completed all learning activities, the minimum actual programme duration is 365 days or more
Description: For aims starting on or after 1 August 2016, that are apprenticeships where FM = 81 or 36 and a programme aim, and the learner has completed all learning activities, then the actual duration of the apprenticeship programme must not be less than 365 days
DetailedDescription:
For aims starting on or after 1 August 2016 (LearningDelivery.LearnStartDate >= 2016-08-01) and on or prior to 31 July 2025 (LearningDelivery.LearnStartDate <= 2025-07-31, that are an apprenticeship standard (LearningDelivery.FundModel = 81 or 36 and LearningDelivery.ProgType = 25), and a programme aim (LearningDelivery.AimType = 1), and the learner has completed all learning activities (LearningDelivery.CompStatus = 2), then the minimum duration of the apprenticeship must not be less than 365 days

(error where LearningDelivery.LearnStartDate - LearningDelivery.LearnActEndDate < 365 days)
Exclusions: This rule is not not triggered by aims that are a restart (LearningDeliveryFAM.LearnDelFAMType = RES)
ChangeSummary: Version 1 - The rule has been rolled over from the previous year
FlowChartDetails:
Flowchart for 'DateOfBirth_47' rule
1. Is the learner record a restart?
If 'Yes' then the rule is not triggeredIf 'No' then:
2. Is the aim a funded apprenticeship standard programme?
If 'No' then the rule is not triggeredIf 'Yes' then
3. Did the apprenticeship start on or after 1 August 2016 and before 31 July 2025?
If 'No' then the rule is not triggeredIf 'Yes' then:
4. Has completion status 2 been recorded on the apprenticeship?
If 'No' then the rule is not triggeredIf 'Yes' then:
5. Is the programme actual duration less than 365 days?
If 'Yes' then the rule is triggeredIf 'No' then the rule is not triggered

LearningDelivery.CompStatus,

ErrorMessage: The payment amounts must not exceed the employer contribution proportion of the total negotiated price
Intent: This rule ensures that there is no over payment of employer contributions for apprenticeship trailblazers.
Guidance: Check that the PMR record to ensure that the employer contribution does not exceed one third of the total negotiated price.
Description: For Apprenticeship trailblazer standards the employer contribution payments recorded for an apprenticeship standard must not exceed the employer contribution proportion of the total negotiated price for the programme.

(error where (SUM( AFinAmount where AFinType = PMR and AFinCode = 1, 2 ) 
MINUS
SUM( AFinAmount where AFinType = PMR and AFinCode = 3 )) 
GREATER THAN
1/3 * (
(AFinAmount where AFinType = TNP and AFinCode = 1 and AFinDate is the most recent) 
PLUS 
(AFinAmount where AFinType = TNP and AFinCode = 2 and AFinDate is the most recent))
ChangeSummary: Version 1 - The rule has been rolled over from the previous year
FlowChartDetails:
Flowchart for 'R72' rule
1. Has the learner been recorded on a trailblazer standard?
If 'No' then the rule is not triggeredIf 'Yes' then:
2. Has more than one Apprenticeship financial record been returned?
If 'No' then the rule is not triggeredIf 'Yes' then:
3. Do the financial records add up to over 1 third of the total value of the negotiated price?

Guidance: If an apprenticeship standard learner has been recorded as completed a TNP 2 record needs to be added onto the learner record which shows the assessment cost for the standard, this will clear the error once returned.
Description: A learner must not have more than one Work placement record with the same Work placement start date.
DetailedDescription:
There must be an assessment price recorded for completed (LearningDelivery.CompStatus = 2) apprenticeship standard (LearningDelivery.ProgType = 25) programmes (LearningDelivery.AimType = 1)

(error where there is no record where (AFinType = TNP and AFinCode = 2 or 4)
Exclusions: (This rule is not triggered by non-funded apprenticeship standards (FundModel = 99 and ProgType = 25))
ChangeSummary: Version 1 - The rule has been rolled over from the previous year
FlowChartDetails:
Flowchart for 'R100' rule
1. Has the learner been recorded on a completed funding model 36 Apprenticeship standard?
If 'No' then the rule is not triggeredIf 'Yes' then:
2. Has a TNP 2 or 4 record been returned?
If 'Yes' then the rule is not triggeredIf 'No' then the rule is triggered

LearningDelivery.AimType,
LearningDelivery.FundModel,
LearningDelivery.ProgType,
LearningDelivery.CompStatus,
AppFinRecord.AFinType,
AppFinRecord.AFinDate

Name: R_101
ErrorMessage: The learning aim must not have more than one Apprenticeship contract type record at the same time
Intent: This rule ensures that there is no overlapping ACT code recorded in the ILR
Guidance: Check that there is not more than one open ACT code recorded for the learner in the ILR, there must not be multiple records active at one time.
Description: A learning aim must not have Learning Delivery FAM records with overlapping dates where the Learning Delivery FAM type is Apprenticeship contract type (ACT) If there is more than one ACT record the 'Date to' of the earlier record must be returned and before the 'date from' of the later record.
DetailedDescription:
A learning aim must not have Learning Delivery FAM records with overlapping dates where the Learning Delivery FAM type is Apprenticeship contract type (ACT) (LearnDelFAMType = ACT).
If there is more than one ACT record (count (records where LearnDelFAMType = ACT) > 1), the 'Date to' of the earlier record must be returned and before the 'date from' of the later record.

(error where LearnDelFAMDateFrom of the ACT is earlier than the LearnDelFAMDateTo of the previous ACT or  LearningDeliveryFAM.LearnDelFAMDateTo is not known)
ChangeSummary: Version 1 - The rule has been rolled over from the previous year
FlowChartDetails:
Flowchart for 'R101' rule
1. Has more than one ACT record been recorded?
If 'No' then the rule is not triggeredIf 'Yes' then:
2. Is there an overlap in the ACT code dates?
If 'No' then the rule is not triggeredIf 'Yes' then the rule is triggered

Name: R_102
ErrorMessage: The aim must have an Apprenticeship contract type in the first day
Intent: This rule ensures that there is an ACT record which starts from the beginning of the apprenticeship programme
Guidance: Check that there is not more than one open ACT code recorded for the learner in the ILR, there must not be multiple records active at one time.
Description: If the Apprenticeship contract type is returned, there must be an apprenticeship contract type that applies from the start of the aim
DetailedDescription:
If the Apprenticeship contract type is returned LearningDelivery.LearnDelFAMType = ACT), there must be an apprenticeship contract type that applies from the start of the aim

(error where there is no record where LearnDelFAMDateFrom = LearnStartDate)
ChangeSummary: Version 1 - The rule has been rolled over from the previous year
FlowChartDetails:
Flowchart for 'R102' rule
1. Has an ACT record been recorded which matches the learning start date?
If 'Yes' then the rule is not triggeredIf 'No' then the rule is triggered

Name: R_104
ErrorMessage: There must be an apprenticeship contract type for the full duration of the aim
Intent: This rule ensures that there is an ACT that covers the whole programme where multiple records are used, if one record ends a new one must start from the following day.
Guidance: Ensure that there is no gap between one ACT record ending and the new one starting, this must be the day after the original one ends.
Description: If there is more than one Apprenticeship contract type record for the learning aim, the Date from and Date to dates must be consecutive.
DetailedDescription:
If there is more than one Apprenticeship contract type record for the learning aim, the Date from and Date to dates must be consecutive.

(error where the LearnDelFAMDateFrom of the ACT record is not a day after the LearnDelFAMDateTo of the previous record (if one exists).
ChangeSummary: Version 1 - The rule has been rolled over from the previous year
FlowChartDetails:
Flowchart for 'R104' rule
1. Has more than one ACT record been recorded? 
If 'No' then the rule is not triggeredIf 'Yes' then:
2. Is there a gap between any of the ACT records?
If 'No' then the rule is not triggeredIf 'Yes' then the rule is triggered

Name: R_105
ErrorMessage: The learner must not have different Apprenticeship contract types recorded at the same time
Intent: This rule ensures that there is not different ACT records open at the same time with different code types, as a learner cannot be Levy and none levy funded a the same time.
Guidance: Ensure that there not two different ACT types open at the same time
Description: A learner must not have different Apprenticeship contract type (ACT) codes across all Learning Delivery Funding and Monitoring records at any point in time.
DetailedDescription:
A learner must not have different Apprenticeship contract type (ACT) codes across all Learning Delivery Funding and Monitoring records at any point in time.

(error where LearnDelFAMType = ACT and count (LearnDelFAMType = ACT) is greater than 1 and 
LearnDelFAMCode does not match across all records at any point in time.
ChangeSummary: Version 1 - The rule has been rolled over from the previous year
FlowChartDetails:
Flowchart for 'R105' rule
1. Has more than one open ACT record been recorded? 
If 'No' then the rule is not triggeredIf 'Yes' then:
2. Is there a different ACT type recorded on either open record?
If 'No' then the rule is not triggeredIf 'Yes' then the rule is triggered

Name: R_106
ErrorMessage: There must not be more than one LSF record at the same time
Intent: This rule ensures that there is only one Learning Support fund record in the ILR
Guidance: Ensure that there are no additional Learning Support Funding records in the ILR for the same learner
Description: At any point in time, a learner must not have more than one Learning support funding record
DetailedDescription:

Name: R_110
ErrorMessage: The employment status is not valid for this apprenticeship contract type
Intent: This rule ensures that there is an employment status record of employed for an apprentice who is funded via the levy
Guidance: Ensure that an employment status of 10 is added to the learners ILR file, if the apprentice is not employed then they are not valid for funding
Description: If an apprenticeship programme is funded through a contract for services with an employer the learner must have an employment status of 'Employed'
DetailedDescription:
If an apprenticeship programme is funded (LearningDelivery.FundModel = 36) through a contract for services with an employer (LearnDelFAMType = ACT and LearnDelFAMCode = 1), the learner must have an employment status of 'Employed'

(error where if the LearnerEmploymentStatus.EmpStat (applicable on LearnDelFAMDateFrom) <> 10)
Exclusions:
Restarts (LearningDeliveryFAM.LearnDelFAMType = RES)
Learner has been made redundant (EmploymentStatusMonitoring.ESMType = OET and EmploymentStatusMonitoring.ESMCode =  1) on the latest LearnerEmploymentStatus.DateEmpStatApp
ChangeSummary: Version 1 - The rule has been rolled over from the previous year
FlowChartDetails:
Flowchart for 'R110' rule
1. Has ACT 1 been recorded? 
If 'No' then the rule is not triggeredIf 'Yes' then:
2. Is the apprentice recorded as Employed?
If 'Yes' then the rule is not triggeredIf 'No' then the rule is triggered

Name: R_114
ErrorMessage: The learner is currently apprenticeship funded and cannot start an Adult skills funded English/maths aim
Intent: This rule ensures that an adult skills funded English and Maths aim is not started if the learner is enrolled on an apprenticeship
Guidance: Remove the English and Maths aim which is funded through adult skills and replace it with a functional skills aim if applicable which is funded as part of the apprenticeship
Description: For starts on or prior to 31 July 2024 an Adult skills funded English or maths aim cannot be started while a learner is on an apprenticeship funded programme
DetailedDescription:
For starts on or prior to 31 July 2024 (LearningDelivery.LearnStartDate <= 2024-07-31) an Adult skills funded English or maths aim (DD31 = Y) cannot be started while a learner is on an apprenticeship funded programme (DD32 = Y). 

(error where (LearningDelivery.LearnStartDate DD31 = Y) >= (LearningDelivery.LearnStartDate DD32 = Y))
ChangeSummary: Version 1 - The rule has been rolled over from the previous year
FlowChartDetails:
Flowchart for 'R114' rule
1. Has an apprenticeship been recorded on or before the 31 July 24? 
If 'No' then the rule is not triggeredIf 'Yes' then:
2. Has an adult skills English and Maths aim been recorded?
If 'No' then the rule is not triggeredIf 'Yes' then the rule is triggered

Name: R_119
ErrorMessage: The apprenticeship financial record cannot be before the Learning start date when the total negotiated price has been returned
Intent: This rule ensures that the apprenticeship financial records are not added prior to the start of the apprenticeship
Guidance: Check the dates which have been added onto the initial financial records to ensure that they match the learner start date, if the learner start date is incorrect this will need to be updated to ensure both records match.
Description: For starts on or after 1st February 2019, if the Total negotiated price is returned then the Apprenticeship financial record date must not be before the Learning start date of the learner's learning aim
DetailedDescription:
For starts on or after 1st February 2019 (LearningDelivery.LearnStartDate >= 2019-02-01), if the Total negotiated price is returned (AppFinRecord.AFinType = TNP and AppFinRecord.AFinCode is not null)  then the Apprenticeship financial record date must not be before the Learning start date of the learner's learning aim

(error where AppFinRecord.AFinDate < LearningDelivery.LearnStartDate)
ChangeSummary: Version 1 - The rule has been rolled over from the previous year
FlowChartDetails:
Flowchart for 'R119' rule
1. Has an apprenticeship been recorded? 
If 'No' then the rule is not triggeredIf 'Yes' then:
2. Is the TNP record date before to the learning start date of the apprenticeship?
If 'No' then the rule is not triggeredIf 'Yes' then the rule is triggered

Name: R_121
ErrorMessage: There must be a Date applies to that matches the achievement date for this aim.
Intent: This rule ensures that the ACT to date matches the achievement date once it is entered into the ILR
Guidance: If the achievement date has been entered onto the apprenticeship standard then the ACT to date must be added which matches this date to clear the error.
Description: For apprenticeship standards, if there is record of an Apprenticeship Contract Type that has been returned and the achievement date has been returned then the Date applies to for the latest ACT record must be the same as the Achievement date
DetailedDescription:
For apprenticeship standards (FundModel = 36, ProgType = 25), if there is record of an Apprenticeship Contract Type that has been returned (LearningDeliveryFAM.LearnDelFAMType =ACT), and the achievement date has been returned (LearningDelivery.AchDate is known), then the Date applies to for the latest ACT record must be the same as the Achievement date (LearningDelivery.AchDate)


(error where LearningDelivery.AchDate <> LearningDeliveryFAM.LearnDelFAMDateTo of the ACT record)
ChangeSummary: Version 1 - The rule has been rolled over from the previous year
FlowChartDetails:
Flowchart for 'R121' rule
1. Has an apprenticeship standard been recorded? 
If 'No' then the rule is not triggeredIf 'Yes' then:
2. Has the achievement date been recorded?
If 'No' then the rule is not triggeredIf 'Yes' then:
3. Does the ACT to date match the achievement date?
If 'Yes' then the rule is not triggeredIf 'No' then the rule is triggered

Name: R_122
ErrorMessage: The achievement date is not known, therefore the Date applies to record must be the same as the Learning actual end date
Intent: This rule ensures that if the learner has been recorded as completed or withdrawn the latest ACT to date matches the actual end date if the achievement date has not been entered into the ILR
Guidance: If the achievement date has not been entered and the learner has withdrawn or been recorded as completed then the ACT to date must match the actual end date.
Description: For apprenticeship standards  if the Completion status is not continuing and there is record of an Apprenticeship Contract Type that has been returned and the achievement date has not been returned then the Date applies to for the latest ACT record must be the same as the Learning Actual End Date
DetailedDescription:
For apprenticeship standards (FundModel =36, ProgType = 25) if the Completion status <>1 (LearningDelivery.CompStatus <> 1) and there is record of an Apprenticeship Contract Type that has been returned (LearningDeliveryFAM.LearnDelFAMType =ACT), and the achievement date has not been returned (LearningDelivery.AchDate is unknown) then the Date applies to for the latest ACT record must be the same as the Learning Actual End Date
  

(error where LearningDeliveryFAM.LearnDelFAMDateTo of the latest ACT record <> LearningDelivery.LearnActualEndDate )
ChangeSummary: Version 1 - The rule has been rolled over from the previous year
FlowChartDetails:
Flowchart for 'R122' rule
1. Has an apprenticeship standard been recorded as completed? 
If 'No' then the rule is not triggeredIf 'Yes' then:
2. Has the achievement date been recorded?
If 'Yes' then the rule is not triggeredIf 'No' then:
3. Does the ACT to date match the actual end date?
If 'Yes' then the rule is not triggeredIf 'No' then the rule is triggered

Name: R_123
ErrorMessage: The learner is continuing or intending to continue, therefore do not return the 'Date applies to' for the latest ACT record
Intent: This rule ensures that if the learner is continuing the apprenticeship standard the ACT to date is not returned
Guidance: Ensure that the ACT to date is not returned where the learner is recorded as continuing, if the learner has completed the actual end date should be updated accordingly
Description: For apprenticeship standards  if the Completion status is not continuing and there is record of an Apprenticeship Contract Type that has been returned and the achievement date has not been returned then the Date applies to for the latest ACT record must be the same as the Learning Actual End Date
DetailedDescription:
For apprenticeship standards (FundModel =36, ProgType = 25),if the 'learner is continuing or intending to continue the learning activities leading to the learning aim' (LearningDelivery.CompStatus = 1) then the Date applies to for the latest ACT record must not be returned

(error where LearningDeliveryFAM.LearnDelFAMDateTo of the latest ACT record is known)
ChangeSummary: Version 1 - The rule has been rolled over from the previous year
FlowChartDetails:
Flowchart for 'R123' rule
1. Has an apprenticeship standard been recorded as continuing? 
If 'No' then the rule is not triggeredIf 'Yes' then:
2. Has the ACT "to" date been returned?
If 'No' then the rule is not triggeredIf 'Yes' then the rule is triggered

Name: R_124
ErrorMessage: The learner must not have overlapping programme aims
Intent: This rule ensures that there are no overlapping programme aims recorded for the apprenticeship
Guidance: Ensure that there is no overlap in dates on the programme aims, there must be at least one day difference between the end of one programme and the start of a new programme aim.
Description: A learner must not have overlapping Programme aims
DetailedDescription:
A learner must not have overlapping Programme aims (LearningDelivery.AimType = 1) based upon the start date (LearningDelivery.LearnStartDate) and the effective end date of the learning aim (DD36)

(error where LearningDelivery.LearnStartDate of any programme aim is between LearningDelivery.LearnStartDate and effective end date (DD36) of any other programme aim)
ChangeSummary: Version 1 - The rule has been rolled over from the previous year
FlowChartDetails:
Flowchart for 'R124' rule
1. Is there overlapping programme aims recorded for the learner? 
If 'No' then the rule is not triggeredIf 'Yes' then the rule is triggered

DetailedDescription:

Name: R_132
ErrorMessage: Learner must be unemployed or return LDM 382 'Free Courses for Jobs (Level 3 Offer) for Low Wage Learners'
Intent: This rule ensures learners who have a prior attainment of full level 3 or above, who have the free courses for jobs LDM code recorded are unemployed or a low wage learner
Guidance: Ensure that if the LDM code 382 is returned for learners who have a full level 3 prior attainment and is studying an applicable programme, they are unemployed or valid for Low wage provision
Description: For starts on or after 1st April 2022 and on or prior to 31 July 2024 if the learner's Prior Attainment is full level 3 or above and the 'Level 3 Free Courses for Jobs' Learning Delivery Monitoring code has been returned then the learner must be unemployed on benefits or be a Free Courses for Jobs (Level 3 Offer) Low Wage Learner using LDM 382
DetailedDescription:
For starts on or after 1st April 2022 (LearningDelivery.LearnStartDate >= 2022-04-01), and on or prior to 31 July 2024 (LearningDelivery.LearnStartDate =< 2024-07-31) if the learner's Prior Attainment is full level 3 or above (PriorAttain.PriorLevel = 6,7,8,9,10, 97 or 98) and the 'Level 3 Free Courses for Jobs' Learning Delivery Monitoring code has been returned (LearningDeliveryFAM.LearnDelFAMType = LDM and LearningDeliveryFAM.LearnDelFAMCode = 378) then the learner must be unemployed on benefits or be a Free Courses for Jobs (Level 3 Offer) Low Wage Learner

error where 
LearningDelivery.LearnStartDate >= 2022-04-01
and 
PriorAttain.PriorLevel = 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 97 or 98
and
LearningDeliveryFAM.LearnDelFAMType = LDM and LearningDeliveryFAM.LearnDelFAMCode = 378
and
DD38 = N 
and 
there is no record where LearningDeliveryFAM.LearnDelFAMType = LDM and LearningDeliveryFAM.LearnDelFAMCode = 382
Exclusions: This rule is not trigged for devolved authorities where the delivery exclusion is used (LearningDeliveryFAM.LearnDelFAMType = DAM and LearningDeliveryFAM.LearnDelFAMCode = 023)
ChangeSummary: Version 1 - The rule has been rolled over from the previous year
FlowChartDetails:
Flowchart for 'R132' rule
1. Is the learners start date after 1st April 2022  and before the  31 July 2024?
If 'No' then the rule is not triggeredIf 'Yes' then:
2. Has DAM code 023 been returned?
If 'Yes' then the rule is not triggeredIf 'No' then:
3. Has the learner been recorded with a prior attainment of full level 3 or above and DFE funded with LDM code 378? 
If 'No' then the rule is not triggeredIf 'Yes' then:
4. Is the learner recorded as unemployed?
If 'Yes' then the rule is not triggeredIf 'No' then:
5. Is the learner recorded with LDM 382?
If 'Yes' then the rule is not triggeredIf 'No' then the rule is triggered
FieldValues:
PriorAttain.PriorLevel,
PriorAttain.DateLevelApp,
LearningDelivery.LearnStartDate,
LearningDeliveryFAM.LearnDelFAMType,
LearningDeliveryFAM.LearnDelFAMCode,
EmploymentStatusMonitoring.ESMCode,
EmploymentStatusMonitoring.ESMType,
LearnerEmploymentStatus.EmpStat

Name: R_137
ErrorMessage: An occupational specialism learning aim (ZTLOSxxx) needs to be present in the learning delivery record
Intent: This rule ensures that occupational specialism learning aim is present on T Level programmes
Guidance: Ensure that a ZTLOSxxx learning aim has been added to the learner record for a T level programme

For open apprenticeship standard programmes started on or after 1 August 2022 where the learner has previously withdrawn (LearningDelivery.CompStatus =3) or temporarily withdrawn due to an agreed break in learning (LearningDelivery.CompStatus =  6) the apprenticeship financial record date for a total negotiated price record on that withdrawn programme aim must not be on or after the learning start date of an open programme aim.

and

and

and there is a closed apprenticeship standard programme aim 
AimType = 1
And

and

Name: R_148
ErrorMessage: The learner must be earning below the earnings threshold by returning LDM 391 or the learner's prior attainment must be below a full level 3
Intent: This rule ensures adult skills fund funding is allocated correctly using the learnings threshold
Guidance: Ensure that both the T level technical qualification and occupational specialism match in LARS database, update the ILR accordingly to ensure that the correct T level is recorded
Description: For starts on or after 1st August 2024, and the 'Level 3 Free Courses for Jobs' Learning Delivery Monitoring code has been returned for learners aged between 19 -23 at the start of the aim, then the learner must be earning below the earnings threshold or the learner's Prior Attainment is below a full level 3
DetailedDescription:
For starts on or after 1st August 2024 (LearningDelivery.LearnStartDate >= 2024-08-01),  and the 'Level 3 Free Courses for Jobs' Learning Delivery Monitoring code has been returned (LearningDeliveryFAM.LearnDelFAMType = LDM and LearningDeliveryFAM.LearnDelFAMCode = 378) for learners aged between 19 -23 at the start of the aim ((LearningDelivery.LearnStartDate - Learner.DateOfBirth) >= 19 years and <=23 years) then the learner must be earning below the earnings threshold (LearningDeliveryFAM.LearnDelFAMType = LDM and LearningDeliveryFAM.LearnDelFAMCode = 391) or the learner's Prior Attainment is below a full level 3  (PriorAttain.PriorLevel =1,2,3,4,5,99)

error where 
LearningDelivery.LearnStartDate >= 2024-08-01
and 
LearningDeliveryFAM.LearnDelFAMType = LDM and LearningDeliveryFAM.LearnDelFAMCode = 378
and
LearningDelivery.LearnStartDate - Learner.DateOfBirth >= 19 years and <=23 years
and
there is no record where LearningDeliveryFAM.LearnDelFAMType = LDM and LearningDeliveryFAM.LearnDelFAMCode = 391
and
there is no record where PriorAttain.PriorLevel =1,2,3,4,5,99
ChangeSummary: Version 1 - The rule has been rolled over from the previous year
FlowChartDetails:
Flowchart for 'R148' rule
1. Has a the learner started on a DFE funded free courses for jobs aim after the 1st of August 2024? 
If 'No' then the rule is not triggeredIf 'Yes' then:
2. Is the learner between the age of 19-23 at the start of the aim?
If 'No' then the rule is not triggeredIf 'Yes' then the rule is triggered
3. Does the learner has a prior attainment below a full level 3?
If 'Yes' then the rule is not triggeredIf 'No' then:
4. Has the earnings threshold LDM code been returned?
If 'Yes' then the rule is not triggeredIf 'No' then the rule is triggered

Name: R_151
ErrorMessage: If the learner is earning below the earnings threshold, LDM 391 must be returned
Intent: This rule ensures that if the level 3 free courses for jobs has been returned for a learner who is 24 that they are earning under the earnings threshold
Guidance: Ensure that if the learner is 24 at the start of the aim and recorded on level 3 free courses for jobs that the learner is also earning below the earnings threshold and recorded with LDM 391
Description: For starts on or after 1st August 2024 for learners aged 24  at the start of the aim who are Adult Skills fund funded  and the 'Level 3 Free Courses for Jobs' Learning LDM code 378 has been returned, the learner must be earning below the earnings threshold and recorded with LDM 391
DetailedDescription:
For starts on or after 1st August 2024 (LearningDelivery.LearnStartDate >= 2024-08-01),  for learners aged 24  at the start of the aim (LearningDelivery.LearnStartDate - Learner.DateOfBirth >= 24 years)    who are Adult Skills fund funded (LearningDelivery.FundModel = 38) and the 'Level 3 Free Courses for Jobs' Learning Delivery Monitoring code has been returned (LearningDeliveryFAM.LearnDelFAMType = LDM and LearningDeliveryFAM.LearnDelFAMCode = 378), then the learner must be earning below the earnings threshold (LearningDeliveryFAM.LearnDelFAMType = LDM and LearningDeliveryFAM.LearnDelFAMCode = 391) 

error where 
LearningDelivery.LearnStartDate >= 2024-08-01
and 
LearningDelivery.LearnStartDate - Learner.DateOfBirth >= 24 years
and
LearningDelivery.FundModel = 38
and
LearningDeliveryFAM.LearnDelFAMType = LDM and LearningDeliveryFAM.LearnDelFAMCode = 378
and
there is no record where LearningDeliveryFAM.LearnDelFAMType = LDM and LearningDeliveryFAM.LearnDelFAMCode = 391
Exclusions: This rule is not triggered for devolved authorities where the delivery exclusion is used (LearningDeliveryFAM.LearnDelFAMType = DAM and LearningDeliveryFAM.LearnDelFAMCode = 023
ChangeSummary: Version 1 - The rule has been rolled over from the previous year
FlowChartDetails:
Flowchart for 'R151 rule
1. Has the learner been recorded with a Devolved delivery exclusion (DAM 023)?
If 'Yes' then the rule is not triggeredIf 'No' then:
2. Has the learner enrolled on a Adult Skills fund funded level 3 free courses for jobs aim after the 1st of August 2024? 
If 'No' then the rule is not triggeredIf 'Yes' then:
3. Is the learner aged 24 or over at the start of the aim?
If 'No' then the rule is not triggeredIf 'Yes' then: 
4. Is the learner recorded as earning under the earnings threshold (LDM 391)?
If 'Yes' then the rule is not triggeredIf 'No' then the rule is triggered

DetailedDescription:

(error where LearningDelivery.OrigLearnStartDate is returned

Level 3 Free Courses for Jobs (LearningDeliveryFAM.LearnDelFAMType = LDM and LearningDeliveryFAM.LearnDelFAMCode = 378)

Name: DateOfBirth_56
ErrorMessage: The learning aim started on or after 1 August 2024 and the learner is 24 or over and the aim is Level 3 or above and the Funding model is Adult Skills Fund
Intent: To ensure that learners starting aims on or after 1 August 2024, where the learner is 24 or over at the start of the aim, where the aim is level 3 or above, then the Funding model cannot be Adult skills fund
Guidance: Ensure that, for aims starting on or after 1 August 2024, where the learner is 24 or over at the start of the aim, where the aim is level 3 or above, then the Funding model must not be Adult skills fund
Description: For aims starting on or after 1 August 2024, where the learner is 24 or over at the start of the aim and the notional NVQ level of the aim is level 3 or above, then the Funding model must not be Adult skills fund
DetailedDescription:
If the learning aim started on or after 1 August 2024 (LearningDelivery.LearnStartDate >= 2024-08-01) and the learner is 24 or over at the start of the aim (LearningDelivery.LearnStartDate - Learner.DateOfBirth >= 24 years) and the notional NVQ level of the aim is level 3 or above (LARS_NotionalNVQLevel_v2 = 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8 or = H), then the Funding model must not be Adult Skills Fund 

(error where LearningDelivery.FundModel = 38)
Exclusions:
This rule is not triggered by Restarts (LearningDeliveryFAM.LearnDelFAMTyp = RES)
A Levels (LARS_LearnAimRefType = '0002', '1413', '1430', '1431' and '1453'(where LearningDelivery.LearnAimRef = LARS_LearnAimRef)) 

Full funding for learners in devolved areas (LearningDeliveryFAM.LearnDelFAMType = DAM and LearningDeliveryFAM.LearnDelFAMCode = 023)

Level 3 Free Courses for Jobs (LearningDeliveryFAM.LearnDelFAMType = LDM and LearningDeliveryFAM.LearnDelFAMCode = 378)

Project S Pilot for Adult Skills Fund Providers (LearningDeliveryFAM.LearnDelFAMType = LDM and LearningDeliveryFAM.LearnDelFAMCode = 395)
ChangeSummary: Version 1 - The rule has been rolled over from the previous year
FlowChartDetails:
Flowchart for 'DateOfBirth_56' rule
1. Is the aim a restart, A level, fully funded devolved, Free courses for jobs or Project S Pilot?
If 'Yes' then the rule is not triggeredIf 'No' then:
2. Is the aim start on or after 1 August 2024?
If 'No' then the rule is not triggeredIf 'Yes' then:
3. Is the learner is 24 or over at the start of the aim?
If 'No' then the rule is not triggeredIf 'Yes' then:

If 'Yes' then the rule is triggeredIf 'No' then the rule is not triggered

Name: AppSerAgeEligibility_01
ErrorMessage: This learner does not meet the age eligibility criteria for this standard on the start date of the programme aim
Intent: The apprenticeship funding rules specify which standards have an age eligibility criteria for learners. This rule prevents these standards from being started as the learner does not meet the age eligibility for the specific standard on the start date of the programme.
Guidance: Ensure that for Learning aims starting after the 1 August 2026, that is an Apprenticeship funded programme aim, only eligible learners based on age are valid for the standard at the start of the programme.
Description: For Learning aims starting after the 1 August 2026, that are Apprenticeship funded programme aims, only eligible learners based on age are valid for the standard at the start of the programme
DetailedDescription:
Where the learning aim started on or after 1 August 2026 (LearningDelivery.LearnStartDate >= 2026-08-01), and are a funded apprenticeship standard (LearningDelivery.FundModel = 36 and LearningDelivery.ProgType =25) and a programme aim (LearningDelivery.AimType = 1), only eligible learners based on age (LearningDelivery.LearnStartDate - Learner.DateOfBirth) are valid for the standard (LearningDelivery.StdCode) on the start date of the programme. 
(error where (LearningDelivery.LearnStartDate - Learner.DateOfBirth) > than the defined age eligibility specified for this standard (LearningDelivery.StdCode) on the start date of the programme aim (LearningDelivery.LearnStartDate))
Exclusions: Aims that are a restart (LearningDeliveryFAM.LearnDelFAMType = RES)
ChangeSummary: Version 3 - This rule is New at version 3
FlowChartDetails:
Flowchart for 'AppSerAgeEligibility_01' rule
1. Is the aim a Restart? 
If 'Yes' rule not triggered If 'No' then:
2. Is the aim start on or after 1 August 2026?
If 'No' rule not triggered If 'Yes' then:
3. Is the aim a funded apprenticeship standard programme (FM  = 36, ProgType = 25 and AimType = 1)?
If 'No' rule not triggered If 'Yes' then:
4. Does the age of the learner exceed the defined age eligibility for this standard on the start date of the programme aim? 
If 'Yes' then the rule is triggeredIf 'No' then the rule is not triggered

LearningDelivery.LearnStartDate,
